name: Scene Editing
aliases: Editing scenes by changing trained neural descriptors
definition: A technique to modify specific spatial regions of a generated 3D scene by treating the 3D coarse latent as an image and applying diffusion-based inpainting.
summary: Scene editing modifies specific spatial regions of a 3D scene via diffusion-based inpainting on coarse latents, enabling localized changes without regenerating the entire volume.
